A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the production mechanism of the isoscalar meson is different from that of the isovector mesons.
the production of the isoscalar mesonic states in the proton diffractive process is not understood in any conventional picture of the interaction.
the data are consistent with a model where the production of the D and E/iota mesons are the result of gluon interactions in the collision.
The main takeaway from our work is that
gluons are not confined to hadrons and can interact in a free manner.
the mesonic resonances observed in diffractive dissociations of protons at ISR energies are produced with dominant gluon helicity.
the production of the D (1285) and iota(1422) mesons in proton-proton scattering can be explained by gluon-gluon interactions.
